name: Tang Chee Hong
title: Engineering Manager
summary: I build digital insurance platforms and grow engineering teams — connecting hands-on development, architecture modernization and regional delivery.
sourceNote: Etiqa career progression and achievements updated with information supplied directly by Tang Chee Hong for 2015–2026.

education.title: Bachelor’s Degree (Honours) in Computer Science
education.description: Completed a Bachelor’s Degree (Honours) in Computer Science at USM, Malaysia.

education.title: Adobe Flash & Dreamweaver
education.description: Certified expert in Adobe Flash and Dreamweaver.

education.title: Google Analytics
education.description: Attended Google Analytics Basic and Advanced courses.

roles.summary: Turning industrial training into practical tools for everyday work.
bullets: Created web applications with ASP.NET and C# using Visual Studio 2005 during industrial training.
Worked on E-Leave, IT Service and Stationery Order applications.
Customized and designed a SharePoint Portal Server 2003 portal.

roles.summary: Taking ownership of interfaces, from the first design to implementation.
bullets: Developed, designed and implemented company websites and user-friendly web application interfaces.
Independently handled the design of web application sections.
Used CSS, JavaScript and jQuery alongside Adobe Dreamweaver and Photoshop, with SEO knowledge to support website visibility.

roles.summary: Bringing website development, online shopping and hands-on support together.
bullets: Developed, designed and maintained company websites and the online e-store.
Enhanced existing web features to make online purchasing easier.
Built promotional web applications, including Facebook applications, with the marketing department.
Provided product support by answering daily user calls and resolving problems on site.

roles.summary: Building the front end of websites, web games and learning applications.
bullets: Owned front-end UI development for websites, web games and web applications.
Worked closely with back-end colleagues to create web applications using HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, Backbone.js and MongoDB.

roles.summary: Progressed from web development to engineering management, building digital insurance platforms and expanding regional delivery across Singapore and Malaysia.
bullets: Built web applications from scratch, designed and developed RESTful APIs for vendors, and integrated with core systems through web services.
Worked on DBS payment integration and the MyInfo government API.
Led the team to deliver projects on time and within scope, managed deployments and coordinated resources for project launches.
Trained team members and managed relationships with the team and stakeholders.
projects: Online System — GI and Life products

achievements.title: Launched the First Online Insurance Platform
achievements.description: Helped build Etiqa Singapore’s first online insurance platform and launched its first online Travel Insurance product within six months, laying the foundation for digital distribution.

achievements.title: Expanded the Digital Product Portfolio
achievements.description: Delivered multiple Personal Accident insurance products and improved SEO and user experience to support online sales growth.

achievements.title: Launched Singapore’s First Online Endowment Plan
achievements.description: Led the launch of Etiqa Singapore’s first online endowment insurance plan within two weeks, expanding digital distribution into life insurance.

achievements.title: Established the Johor Bahru Technology Office
achievements.description: Set up the JB development office to support Singapore, recruiting and mentoring developers to expand engineering delivery capacity.

achievements.title: Transformed Legacy Architecture
achievements.description: Led the transition from a monolithic system to a microservices architecture. Extended the modernization to Malaysia and launched a new Travel Insurance product within four months.

achievements.title: Completed Malaysia’s Platform Migration
achievements.description: Migrated six major insurance products and decommissioned the legacy online system, contributing to Etiqa regaining Malaysia’s No. 1 position in online Travel Insurance.

achievements.title: Scaled Engineering Capacity
achievements.description: Expanded the Johor Bahru technology centre to more than 80 engineers, strengthening in-house development capability and regional delivery capacity.

achievements.title: Developed a Unified Regional Platform
achievements.description: Built a single-codebase, single-instance platform to support regional markets, enabling shared capabilities and reducing duplicated development across countries.
